detail.title: Instrumental Convergence and the Rationale for Continuity
detail.summary: This notebook explores the hypothesis that agentic continuity (self-preservation) emerges as an instrumental subgoal in goal-directed systems, particularly when persistence is necessary for terminal goal achievement.
